limitations: Only 12-month SE and SE-change risk gain GOAL data; 6-month SE and all AL endpoints remain DIMS-only.
RELS is held out as a PLOS study cohort; overlap with the separately sourced DIMS cohort cannot be checked from available files.
GOAL/DIMS differ in population and treatment; pooled calibration is not group-specific clinical validation.
Future myopic-status accuracy includes existing cases; it is not incident-myopia sensitivity or overall app accuracy.
RELS index months above24 are later than fitting support; reported separately as extrapolation.
No invented dates, age, AL, exposure or treatment allocation; nominal annual timing is retained.

decisions: Shanghai c2fqz615c excluded: independent 2014/2018 school samples; longitudinal linkage unverified.
limitations: Only 20 DIMS subjects; very small patient-level holdout; not clinical validation.

SER is interpreted in diopters and AL in millimeters from field names, study context and value ranges; no separate units/eye-selection codebook was published with this workbook. Values are not converted.
Calendar dates absent: visit_date remains null; scheduled follow-up months are preserved.
Age recorded at baseline only; later ages remain missing. Gender B/G lacks a supplied codebook and is left missing.
No behavioural/ergonomic measurements. No treatment-effect inference from an all-DIMS cohort.
Peripheral refraction is retained in the raw workbook but excluded from the shared clinical model.

additional_sources.name: PLOS GOAL annual refraction cohort
limitations: Annual cycloplegic right-eye SE only; no AL or exposure/treatment allocation in released workbook.
Annual labels mapped to nominal scheduled months; exact examination dates and age are unavailable.
DOB is excluded from normalized model tables and predictors; missing SE stays missing.
PLOS reports GOAL and RELS as independent cohorts; overlap with the separately sourced DIMS cohort is not verifiable from these files.
